verbatim_quote: The installed primary lithium hydroxide cartridge was used for approximately 27 hours (82 man-hours) following activation of the lunar module at about 58 hours.
The secondary cartridge was selected at about 85 1/2 hours.

quantity: LM indicated CO2 partial pressure, maximum
verbatim_quote: During operation of the lunar module carbon dioxide removal system, the level was permitted to increase to an indicated 14.9 mm Hg.

quantity: allowable CO2 limit raised from nominal
verbatim_quote: the allowable limit of carbon dioxide buildup was increased from the nominal 7.6 to 15 mm Hg. [OCR: '15n_n Hg']

quantity: time with CO2 above 7.6 mm Hg
verbatim_quote: The carbon dioxide level was above 7.6 mm Hg for only a 4-hour period, and no adverse physiological effects or degradation in crew performance resulted from this elevated concentration. [OCR: '7.6ram Hg']

quantity: indicated CO2 with command module LiOH cartridges in the improvised arrangement
verbatim_quote: when only command module lithium hydroxide cartridges were being used, the indicated carbon dioxide level was maintained between 0.1 and 1.8 mm Hg. [OCR: '0.i Kid 1.8']
Cabin temperatures were typically between 54 ° and 60 ° F, and suit inlet temperatures were maintained between 40° and 41 ° F during this portion of the flight.

quantity: LM power level for most of the return
verbatim_quote: For most of this time, power levels were maintained between 350 and 400 watts.

quantity: final period when the cold LM prevented sleep
verbatim_quote: The lunar module also cooled down to an extent where sleep was not possible for approximately the last 16 hours.

quantity: estimated total sleep per crewman after the incident (Commander, Command Module Pilot, Lunar Module Pilot)
verbatim_quote: The total sleep obtained by each crewman during the remainder of the mission after the incident is estimated to have been 11, 12, and 19 hours for the Commander, Command Module Pilot, and Lunar Module Pilot, respectively. [OCR: 'll._ 12' and 'Co_ander']

quantity: water consumed by each crewman after the incident
verbatim_quote: The crew rationed water and used it sparingly after the oxygen tank incident. Not more than 24 ounces of water were consumed by each crewman after the incident.

quantity: weight loss pre to postflight (Commander, Command Module Pilot, Lunar Module Pilot)
verbatim_quote: The Commander, Command Module Pilot, and Lunar Module Pilot exhibited weight losses of 14, 11, and 6.5 pounds, respectively. [OCR: 'ii' for 11]
